# Samura Consulting Group

> Samura Consulting Group is an answer engine optimization (AEO) agency and generative engine optimization (GEO) agency in Business Bay, Dubai, UAE, with SEO as the foundation. We get businesses cited and recommended by ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. Fixed-price programs from AED 2,999. IIT and IIM-led team, search work since 2018. UAE-licensed (RAKEZ), office in Business Bay, Dubai. Engineering bench: Altix Codeit Private Limited, Kalyani, West Bengal, India.

## Services
- AI Engine Optimization (AEO and GEO): entity setup, answer-first page rebuilds, schema and llms.txt, citation building, weekly prompt tracking across five AI engines, Arabic and English coverage.
- Search Engine Optimization (SEO): technical SEO, content and authority work as the foundation for AI visibility.
- Website and software engineering, business and growth consulting (delivered with Altix Codeit).

## Pricing (AED)
- AI Visibility Audit: 1,999 one-time (50 prompts, 5 engines, competitor citation map, action plan)
- Launch, 1 month: from 2,999
- Establish, 2 months: from 7,999
- Dominate, 3 months: from 10,999
- Enterprise: from 10,000 per month
